name: BuildaBazaar
description_en:
BuildaBazaar’s official URL now resolves to Rediff Ecommerce. The destination explicitly identifies the platform as formerly BuildaBazaar, providing direct evidence of the product transition rather than an inferred association.

The current offer is enterprise-oriented commerce with catalogue, order and storefront management, payment integrations and B2B capabilities. Other Rediff One products such as email, ERP and CRM appear in navigation but should not be counted as included ecommerce modules without a scoped agreement.
description_zh:
BuildaBazaar 官方地址当前转到 Rediff Ecommerce，目标页面明确写出前身为 BuildaBazaar，这是直接的产品转换证据。

当前方案面向企业电商，涵盖商品目录、订单、店面管理、支付集成及 B2B 功能。导航中的 Rediff One 邮件、ERP、CRM 等其他产品，不能在没有具体协议时算入电商权益。

core_features.explanation_en: Manage products and order fulfilment/invoicing from the platform.
core_features.explanation_zh: 通过平台管理商品及订单履约、开票。

core_features.explanation_en: The offer describes templates, custom checkout flows and API integration.
core_features.explanation_zh: 方案介绍模板、定制结账流程及 API 集成。

Examples and suitability judgments are editorial guidance. Chinese copy does not establish a Chinese product interface.

sections.title_en: Confirm the current product before planning migration
sections.title_zh: 规划迁移前确认当前产品
sections.en: The retrieved destination is one.rediff.com/ecommerce and explicitly names the earlier BuildaBazaar identity. It presents an enterprise package for retail chains, high-volume D2C and wholesale sellers. Historical self-service prices or feature limits should not be carried forward as current facts. Existing customer continuity, migrations and contractual rights still need direct confirmation.
sections.zh: 读取目标为 one.rediff.com/ecommerce，明确提及原 BuildaBazaar，并把企业套餐面向连锁零售、高订单量 D2C 和批发卖家。历史自助价格及功能上限不能直接延续为当前事实。原客户账户、迁移及合同权益仍需另行确认。

sections.title_en: Evaluate a wholesale order with a payment handoff
sections.title_zh: 评估批发订单及支付交接
sections.en: A representative evaluation could load a small wholesale catalogue, assign customer-specific visibility, place an order and inspect payment and fulfilment status. The page describes catalogue management, central order handling, gateway connections and B2B capability, but does not document the exact approval, stock reservation or refund sequence. Request that specific demonstration rather than assuming a listed gateway works with your account.
sections.zh: 可用小型批发目录、客户可见范围、订单及支付履约状态组成代表性评估。页面介绍目录、集中订单处理、支付网关和 B2B 能力，但未说明具体审批、预留库存及退款顺序。应要求展示这些步骤，不能假定列出的网关已适配自己的账户。

sections.title_en: Quote the enterprise scope instead of an old starter plan
sections.title_zh: 按企业范围询价，不沿用旧入门方案
sections.en: The current pricing section offers an Enterprise package through Get Quote, with no verified numeric amount or billing unit. Scope the storefronts, customer groups, integrations, payment costs, migration and support. The page’s hosted-operation positioning does not establish an open-source licence, customer-run deployment or unlimited bespoke work.
sections.zh: 当前定价区通过 Get Quote 提供 Enterprise 套餐，未核实金额及计费单位。应列明店面、客户组、集成、支付费用、迁移和支持。页面中的托管运营定位，不能证明存在开源许可、客户自行部署或无限定制。

sections.title_en: Use an enterprise commerce requirement as the starting point
sections.en: Retail groups and wholesalers have a relevant reason to investigate. A solo merchant seeking a transparent low-price self-service plan cannot establish that fit from this page. Prepare products, tax/shipping inputs, permitted payment accounts and exception cases. No store, refund, API or recovery was tested, and advertised search-visibility or growth effects were not adopted as facts.
sections.zh: 零售集团和批发商有相关评估理由；寻找透明低价自助套餐的个人商家，不能仅凭此页确认适用。应准备商品、税费配送输入、可用支付账户及例外情形。本文未测试店铺、退款、API 或恢复，也不把搜索曝光或增长宣传当作事实。
